Product description
 Woman is always driven by confidence, beauty, and different life challenges, women's devotion to design and quality is reflected in her everyday essentials. We hold the belief that a watch does so much more than control time, it is also part of the women herself which shows from her wrist but tells her story to all the world

This wrist watch in the charming grace will definitely bring you more than the bright beauty. Its romantic and full of fashion designs, to show women's tenderness and charm, to win the attention of favorite female friends
This unique,business,casual,retro and leather strap watch will go great with any outfit and any occasion, it enables you to easily spice up a normal outfit and add style to your life

Specifications
 Case diameter: 20mm (0.79 inch)
 Case thickness: 9mm (0.35 inch)
 Band width: 12mm (0.47 inch)
 Perimeter: 220mm (8.66 inch)
 Weight: 18g

ADVICE FOR USE:
 1.Please wear watch carefully in daily life. Don’t collide your watch,Because it will create a shock to inside movement and electroplated layer of the watch may fade.
2. Use a soft and dry cloth to wipe off moisture, sweat and dirt has accumulated on the watch to maintain the durability of it.
1.Do not wear the watch in hot water baths, saunas or environments with large temperature changes.
2.Do not put a water resistant watch in water while the crown is pulled out. If the watch touch water, dried in time.
3.Avoid placing it directly under running water from a faucet. The water pressure from a faucet is sufficient to result in moisture penetration inside the watch.

items.label: Women Watch Design
items.value: Quartz movement ensures accurate timekeeping for everyday wear. The collision of a slim and flat rectangular case with Roman numerals brings retro charm to modern fashion, showcasing the minimalist, refined and elegant style of modern women

items.label: Retro Womens Watch
items.value: Timeless ladies watch with classic and vintage design, Retro Rectangle Dial / Dainty Leather Band, great for Cocktail Party, Evening Party, Prom or Wedding

items.label: High-Quality Strap
items.value: The strap is made of high-quality leather with a smooth texture,this material is soft to the touch, and its pliable nature conforms to the wrist without discomfort over long periods of time. Adjustable belt length from 14 cm to 20 cm,suitable for most of women’s wrist

items.label: Retro Womens Watch
items.value: Timeless ladies watch with classic and vintage design, Retro Rectangle Dial / Dainty Leather Band, great for Cocktail Party, Evening Party, Prom or Wedding

items.label: Daily Water Resistant
items.value: In general, this watch can withstand splashes or brief immersion in water. However, it is not recommended for swimming or bathing.

items.value: BESTKANG Vintage Rectangle Women Quartz Wrist Watch
